method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Shares unsettled as oil climbs, earnings loom for AI
Equities.reason: Market-wide piece tying higher oil (geopolitical risk) to equity volatility and the upcoming AI-driven earnings cadence — signals downside risk to risk assets and elevated uncertainty ahead of key tech results.

Equities.title: Wall St Week Ahead Alphabet, Intel results in focus for AI trade as US earnings rev up
Equities.reason: Frames the dominant equity narrative: AI-led earnings season (Alphabet, Intel) that can drive the tech-led market rotation and risk appetite — supportive for equities, especially AI/tech exposure.

Equities.title: Chip stock pullback sparks worries about AI rally strength, leveraged trades
Equities.reason: Directly challenges the AI rally by showing chip weakness and leveraged-position unwind — amplifies downside risk to AI/tech leadership and raises volatility for equity markets.

Equities.title: TSMC is accelerating Arizona factory buildout to capitalize on AI 'megatrend,' CFO says
Equities.summary: Speaking in an interview with CNBC, TSMC's Wendell Huang said the fresh investment comes on the back of robust customer demand.
Equities.reason: Concrete capex and capacity expansion by a major chip supplier reinforces the structural bull case for AI demand and supports the tech/semiconductor narrative for equities.

Equities.title: Korea’s AI-Heavy Market Now Sets the Tone for Global Stocks
Equities.reason: Highlights a concentrated AI leadership theme where a single region/sector is disproportionately influencing global equity moves — important for positioning and cross-market flows.

Equities.title: 'I couldn't breathe':South Korea's frenzied stock trading exposes margin loan risks
Equities.reason: Retail leverage and margin-call pain in a major AI/tech market increases tail-risk for regional and global equities — a meaningful governor on risk sentiment and liquidity.

Equities.title: Chinese Traders Unwind Leveraged Bets at Fastest Pace Since 2016
Equities.reason: Large-scale deleveraging in China removes a bid from local equities and can spill into global risk sentiment — bearish for EMEA/APAC equity flows and IPO demand.

Equities.title: Extreme Stock Swings Tempt Funds Into Reverse Dispersion Trade
Equities.reason: Notes elevated intraday/stock-level volatility and strategy shifts (reverse dispersion) — signals higher trading frictions and tactical caution among funds, mildly negative for broad beta.

Equities.title: US, Iran Launch Fresh Strikes After Two Troops Die in Jordan
Equities.reason: Escalating geopolitical conflict raises the oil-risk premium and broad risk-off dynamics — material negative for global equities and likely to increase volatility and sector dispersion.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Rising oil, yields rain on AI party
Rates.reason: Headline flags rising yields as a market theme (yields up / bond selloff). Signals a modest negative impulse for rates markets and broader fixed income.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Take Warsh at Word, See Inflation Fight Continuing
Rates.reason: Reports bond traders interpreting Fed communications as signalling a persistent inflation fight / higher-for-longer rates — a clear negative for bond prices and core yields (high relevance to rates).

Rates.title: Oil Rises as US-Iran Attacks Intensify, Bonds Fall: Markets Wrap
Rates.reason: Geopolitical escalation lifting oil and triggering bond selloff (yields up). Shows cross-asset risk push that is negative for sovereign bonds and central-bank reaction risks.

Rates.title: Will the Fed hike interest rates this month?
Rates.reason: Directly addresses the probability of an imminent Fed rate hike — higher policy path is negative for bond prices and yields (material for rates positioning).

Rates.title: PBOC holds Loan Prime Rates steady in July
Rates.summary: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank, announced to leave its Loan Prime Rates (LPRs) unchanged on Monday. The one-year and five-year LPRs were at 3.00% and 3.50%, respectively.
Rates.reason: PBOC holding the LPR is a neutral/domestic policy signal for Chinese rates — important locally but not a global directional shock for yields.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Money Market Committee meeting – June 2026
Rates.summary: The Money Markets Committee is a forum for market participants and authorities to discuss the UK unsecured deposits and funding market and securities lending and repo markets.
Rates.reason: Committee minutes focus on funding and repo market conditions — relevant to short-term sterling rates and liquidity pricing; slight negative given ongoing tightness/funding focus.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.reason: Minutes on discount rate meetings give insight into Fed lending/operational stance and policy deliberations — likely to reinforce expectations of tighter/unchanged policy, negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: South Korea: Faster hiking path – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economist Ma Tieying analyzes the latest Bank of Korea (BoK) decision, noting a hawkish shift as the base rate is raised to 2.75%. The report now anticipates a faster tightening cycle, with the policy rate reaching 3.25% by year-end 2026.
Rates.reason: DBS expects a faster BoK hiking path and higher policy rate — direct, negative pressure on Korean government bond prices and Asian rates more broadly.

Rates.title: Japanese Government Bonds Held by the Bank of Japan
Rates.reason: BoJ JGB holdings statistics are relevant for JGB supply/demand and yield dynamics but this is routine data with no immediate directional signal; treated as neutral/low relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar edges higher above 0.5850 as softer US inflation dampens Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair holds positive ground near 0.5855 during the early European session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) as softer US inflation data have led traders to cut bets on imminent rate hikes from the US Federal
FX.reason: USD weakness driven by softer US inflation expectations is lifting NZD/USD. This is a direct USD-flow FX signal (USD down -> commodity/FX gains) and reinforces the near-term USD-soft narrative.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Edges higher to near 1.1450 but remains capped below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1445 during the early European trading hours on Monday, bolstered by a hawkish tone from the European Central Bank (ECB).
FX.reason: ECB hawkishness supporting EUR against USD is a core USD-centric FX theme. The piece signals modest EUR strength (USD weakness) tied to central-bank differentials — relevant to the broad FX regime.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher to near 1.4000 as crude oil gains
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair extends its downside to near 1.4005 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. Rising crude oil prices provide some support to the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Oil-driven CAD strength vs USD is a clear USD-flow channel (commodity FX). Oil up -> CAD support is a direct FX-native driver with medium relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index struggles to lure buyers despite Iran tensions, Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick on Monday and currently trades around the 100.80-100.75 region, nearly unchanged for the day.
FX.reason: DXY failing to catch a bid despite geopolitical risk and Fed expectations dampens the USD-strength narrative; modestly negative for USD across FX with limited immediacy.

FX.title: Indian Rupee starts weak negatively as oil prices extend gains
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a weak note against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 96.46 as a fresh surge in oil prices and the consistent outflow of foreign funds from the Indian stock market are hurting the India
FX.reason: Oil-driven import bill pressure and foreign outflows are causing INR weakness (USD strength). This is an EM FX local-stress signal with clear USD-flow implications.

FX.title: Euro: Upside bias holds above key support against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang sees EUR/USD consolidating with a slight downside bias intraday, expecting moves within 1.1405–1.1450. Over 1–3 weeks, the Euro is still viewed with an upside bias as long as 1.1405 holds, though momentum toward 1.15
FX.reason: Bank strategist view reinforces a modest EUR upside bias vs USD — supportive to the broader USD-weak/Europe-hawkish narrative but is a medium-term bank view (limited immediacy).

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Tests 1.4000 after breaking below 50-day EMA
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second successive day. trading around 1.4010 during the Asian hours on Monday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is moving downward within the descending channel, suggesting an ongoing bearish bias.
FX.reason: Technical confirmation of USD/CAD downside supports the CAD-strength via oil/technical flows. Technical pieces are relevant but scored with capped relevance.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Recovers to near 0.7000 amid US Dollar’s weakness
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades 0.12% higher to near 0.6995 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Monday.
FX.reason: AUD is recovering on USD weakness — a direct USD-flow FX signal. As a technical/short-term note, relevance is capped but it reinforces the USD-soft theme.

FX.title: Japanese Yen hangs near four-decade low as bears turn cautious amid intervention risks
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Monday and currently trades just below mid-162.00s amid relatively thin liquidity on the back of a holiday in Japan.
FX.reason: JPY at multi-decade lows with explicit intervention risk is a high-consequence FX story. Intervention risk can quickly reverse flows and is therefore scored with high relevance; current direction implies USD strength / JPY weakness pressure.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Consolidation holds upside bias against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/CNH is currently consolidating in a narrow range around 6.77. In their 1–3 week view, they maintain a downside bias toward 6.7600 as long as strong resistance at 6.7820 remains
FX.reason: Bank strategist expects modest CNH strength (USD/CNH downside) — a medium-horizon EM FX signal that slightly supports USD weakness vs CNY.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as fuel shortages amplify concerns over fiscal strain
FX.summary: USD/IDR halts its four-day losing streak, trading around 18,020 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces headwinds from rising crude oil prices.
FX.reason: IDR weakness tied to oil/fiscal concerns signals EM vulnerability and USD demand; a region-specific negative FX signal with medium relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc gains ground ahead of Trade Balance data
FX.summary: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8070 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair depreciates as the Swiss Franc (CHF) receives support ahead of the release of Trade Balance data for June.
FX.reason: CHF receiving support ahead of data is a modest positive for the franc (USD/CHF downside). It's a short-term, data-driven FX move with limited systemic impact.

FX.title: RBI Intervenes to Support Rupee as Currency Nears Record Low
FX.reason: Official FX intervention by a major EM central bank is a high-relevance event that directly alters USD/INR flows and reduces EM FX stress — positive for the rupee and a material USD-weak signal for the pair.

FX.title: Hedge Funds Amass Biggest New Zealand Dollar Net Short Since 2006
FX.reason: Record short positioning in NZD is a strong flow/positioning signal that can amplify downside pressure on NZD (USD strength vs NZD). It acts as an important counter-signal to spot NZD strength headlines.

FX.title: Dollar firmer as US-Iran conflict intensifies, Brent hits $90
FX.reason: Cross-market piece linking geopolitics and oil to USD strength is a primary macro driver: heightened safe-haven USD demand plus higher oil affect commodity FX and EM — significant negative for non-USD currencies.

FX.title: Safest Carry in Emerging Markets Is in Latin American Currencies
FX.reason: Flows into Latin American carry trades imply USD-funded positions into EM currencies; supportive for those EMFX vs USD and signals persistent carry-seeking behavior in FX markets.

FX.title: South Korea to Ease FX Rules for Foreigners to Trade Won Easier
FX.reason: Policy easing to make won trading easier for foreigners should support capital inflows and the KRW versus USD; it's a structural, policy-driven positive for the won with medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Brent oil tops $90 as US, Iran intensify attacks in Middle East
Commodities.reason: Major Middle East escalation (U.S.-Iran attacks) threatens flows through Hormuz and raised immediate oil-risk premium; large, market-moving bullish signal for crude.

Commodities.title: WTI surges above $83.00 amid escalating US-Iran conflict
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price opened at a bullish gap, trading around $83.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Near-term price breakout on geopolitical supply risk; supports bullish crude price regime and confirms risk-premium repricing.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter

Commodities.reason: Authoritative supply-flow analysis showing Hormuz disruptions have already tightened markets and driven volatility — structural/medium-term bullish for crude.

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: Falling Cushing stocks imply tighter U.S. crude availability — constructive for WTI prices and supports the current oil rally.

Commodities.title: Oil’s Battered Shock Absorbers Risk Price Spike as War Returns
Commodities.reason: Analysis that spare capacity/inventory buffers are thin — amplifies the impact of geopolitical shocks and increases upside risk for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Gold falls toward $4,000 as US-Iran hostilities boosts Fed rate hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to around $4,000 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal hovers around the psychological level in recent weeks after losing 14% in the second quarter (Q2), its worst showing since 2013.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical tensions are paradoxically boosting Fed tightening expectations (risk that Fed hikes stay on table), increasing real rates and weighing on gold's appeal as a non-yielding asset.

Commodities.title: Gold slips as oil prices advance, Fed rate-hike voices grow
Commodities.reason: Major newswire notes oil-driven risk-premium alongside rising rate-hike rhetoric — reinforces the dominant bearish pressure on gold from higher rate expectations.

Commodities.title: Gold extends fragile recovery from monthly low on soft USD; upside seems limited
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses a modest Asian session dip to the $3,983-$3,982 area and is now looking to build on Friday's bounce from the monthly low. The intraday uptick is sponsored by a softer US Dollar (USD), which tends to benefit the commodity.
Commodities.reason: Short-term USD softness provides tactical support, but limited upside given prevailing rate-hike narrative; flagged as a minor counter-signal.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies as Traders Assess Rates Path After US-Iran Clashes
Commodities.reason: Market-assessment piece balancing geopolitical safe-haven demand against rate-policy concerns — modestly bearish overall in the current macro setup.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises toward $57.00 despite Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the second successive day, trading around $56.80 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Silver showing near-term gains despite rate concerns — mixed signals but small positive given current price action and industrial demand linkage.

Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade and rising U.S. export capacity point to structurally stronger gas demand and tighter balances — constructive for natural gas-related prices.

Commodities.title: Coffee drinkers turning to whole beans as prices soar, says Lavazza
Commodities.summary: Chair of Italian family-owned group says consumers are opting for ‘less but better’

Crypto.reason: Market risk-off from an AI-led equity selloff is transmitting into crypto, driving Bitcoin weakness and signalling shorter-term liquidity/flow pressure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs see new money again, but inflows remain ‘peanuts’ relative to the recent exodus

Crypto.title: Kraken says simpler options can unlock crypto's next derivatives market

Crypto.title: Inside Robinhood’s high-stakes bet to onboard millions of casual users onto decentralized finance

Crypto.title: Japan's SBI Group is building Asia's first cross-border digital asset empire
